+ The system shall log each request.
+ When the door opens, the light shall turn on.
+ While the pump runs, the display shall show the pressure.
+ If the pressure is too high, then the valve shall open.
+ Where a printer is installed, the system shall print the report.
+ While the pump runs, when the door opens, the pump shall stop.
+ When the user presses A, B or C, the system shall beep.
- ⟦Once⟧ the door opens, the light shall turn on.
- ⟦As soon as⟧ the door opens, the light shall turn on.
- ⟦If⟧ the pressure is too high, the valve shall open.
- The pump shall stop ⟦when⟧ the tank is full.
- ⟦Shall⟧ the system log requests?
- ⟦For safety reasons⟧, the system shall log each request.
# A statement that says nothing that shall be is found once, over its first sentence.
- ⟦The display shows the time.⟧ It is large.
